verdict.rationale: Loops can be driven without its UI. It has a REST API authenticated by a Bearer API key, a published OpenAPI spec and typed SDKs. A terminal CLI handles contacts, events and transactional sends, and workflows can be created and edited from code. Together these are the building blocks for headless and scripted automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation (e.g., a pipeline example or non-interactive CLI auth via environment variables), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
